title: Add your starting point
detail: List your accounts and debts in Snapshot so your True Number measures from where you really are.

title: Add your take-home income
detail: Enter what lands in your account each month — it turns an assumed timeline into yours.

title: Find your bare-necessities number
detail: Add up rent or mortgage, utilities, groceries, and insurance from last month's statements. It's the floor your plan is built on.

title: Build a {emergencyMonths}-month safety cushion
detail: Park {emergencyTarget} in a high-interest savings account before investing more, so a surprise bill never turns into debt.

title: Clear {debtName} first
detail: At {debtRate}% interest it costs more than investing earns. Point extra cash here until it's gone.

title: Automate your {monthlySavings}/mo the day after payday
detail: Money you never see is money you don't miss. Set up a recurring transfer to your savings and investments.

title: Put {extraMonthly} more a month toward your future
detail: A raise, a cancelled subscription, or a side gig can cover it — and it gets you to your True Number {yearsSaved} sooner.

title: Raise your savings by 1% every six months
detail: Small steps you barely feel add up. Set a reminder for {month} to nudge your automatic transfer up.

title: Tour {density} homes around {city}
detail: Spend one weekend comparing {density} listings with your current target. Choosing {density} would lower your True Number by {deltaTN}.

title: Save three {density} homes you could love
detail: If the feeling holds after a month, update your neighbourhood in Beanstalk and watch your number drop.

title: Run the rent-vs-own numbers for your ideal home
detail: Renting a comparable home would lower your True Number by {deltaTN}. Weigh what owning means to you before deciding.

title: Explore what owning would take
detail: Owning would lower your True Number by {deltaTN}. Start with the down payment — about {downPayment} — and talk to your advisor about a mortgage.

title: Compare {cityTarget} and {city} side by side
detail: The same ideal life costs {deltaTN} less in {cityTarget}. Look at jobs in your field, schools, and how far you'd be from family.

title: Take a scouting trip to {cityTarget}
detail: Spend a long weekend living like a local — groceries, commute, a neighbourhood you could see yourself in.

title: Try a {tier} month
detail: For one month, spend at a {tier} pace on dining and outings. Notice what you actually miss — that's your real lifestyle.

title: Pause {category} for 90 days
detail: Redirect what you'd spend into savings. If you don't miss it, letting it go lowers your True Number by {deltaTN}.

title: Decide how much cushion you really need
detail: Moving from {tierFrom} to {tierTo} security lowers your True Number by {deltaTN}. Write down what the extra cushion is for — if you can't name it, you may not need it.

title: Review your investment mix with your advisor
detail: A {approachTo} approach could lower your True Number by {deltaTN}, with bigger ups and downs along the way. Make sure you're comfortable with the risk first.
notes: Never name products; always routes to an advisor

title: Try {incomeIdea} for three months
detail: {incomeTaskText}
notes: Uses the chosen catalog row's taskTemplate as the detail

title: Book a compensation review before {month}
detail: Bring what you deliver and what the role pays elsewhere. A {raiseMonthly}/mo raise gets you there {yearsSaved} sooner.

title: Make sure one bad year can't undo your plan
detail: Review life and disability coverage so an illness or job loss doesn't set you back years. A quick advisor check covers it.

title: Put a will in place
detail: Make sure what you build goes where you want it to — especially once others depend on you.

title: Check in on your True Number
detail: Update your accounts in Snapshot and see how far you've come since {lastCheckIn}.

title: Book your annual plan review
detail: Bring your True Number and this plan. Ask what changed this year and what to adjust.

title: Protect one screen-free evening a week
detail: No pings, no scrolling — just the people you love. This is what the plan is for.

title: Start a "home worth never leaving" wish list
detail: Write down what would make a home the one you'd never leave. It sharpens every housing decision ahead.

title: Name the one experience you would fund first
detail: Pick it and price it. A life without price tags starts with knowing what you'd say yes to.

title: Write down who you want to provide for
detail: A legacy goal is easier to fund when it has names attached. Bring the list to your next plan review.

title: Find your walk-away number
detail: Your savings cover about {runwayMonths} months of bare necessities today. Watch that number climb as your plan works.
